about.text:
After graduating from high school, I went to California to pursue a Liberal Arts education in California. I was selected as what Pitzer College calls an International Scholar, aided a full-ride scholarship to study at the Claremont Colleges.

Majoring through Pomona College, I concentrated in Behavioral Economics as part of my PPE studies, and on my senior year wrote my thesis concentrating on Political Philosophy and International Relations: I wrote on democratic backsliding.

roles.title: Art Gallery Assistant
bullets: Supported installation, reception logistics, and outreach for exhibitions *Aurora* (Valeria Tizol Vivas) and *Las Tres Gracias* (Jimena Sarno), creating promotional materials including flyers and email graphics.
Managed weekend gallery operations: opened the space, set up A/V and visuals, and prepared the gallery for visitors.
Welcomed guests, provided programs, served as the on-site contact, and led exhibition walkthroughs.

roles.title: Theatre Assistant
bullets: Supported front-of-house operations, including box office, ushering, and event coordination.
Worked weekly in the costume shop, tailoring garments for three productions.
Assisted in the scene shop, building props and supporting technical production needs.

roles.title: Production Assistant
bullets: Maintained flexible, on-call working hours to accommodate attorneys, clients, and production teams while conducting fieldwork across New York City for interviews, visiting courts, and capturing documentary footage.
Collaborated with videographers and attorneys to produce Video Mitigation Projects — editing advocacy videos.

entries.org: Sancharika Samuha: Forum of Women Journalists & Communicators

roles.title: Editor
bullets: Collaborated with Nepali Supreme Court Justice Sapana Pradhan Malla to enhance representation of women journalists in media, and provided support in organizing and coordinating events promoting equity-based development.

roles.title: Event Staff Manager
bullets: Oversaw the event calendar for the Fall '25 semester, supervised and trained a new Event Staff team of 10 students, and managed technical operations including sound equipment setup and troubleshooting.

roles.title: Event Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated and executed over 100 campus-wide events across the Claremont Colleges for over 8,000 students.
Led outreach and promotion through digital and physical campaigns, including flyers, murals, email graphics, tabling on campus, and collaborating with student organizations to maximize participation.

entries.org: PEN America / Russian Independent Media Archives

roles.title: Event Coordinator
bullets: Planned and executed multiple events, including a Hackathon, World Cafe, and a gala for journalists in exile, coordinating logistics between PEN America, RIMA, and international journalists.

Designed outreach materials across social media platforms as well as physical media across the boroughs, and managed outreach campaigns to journalists worldwide and New York's Russian-speaking community to expand event participation and visibility.
